description: AbstractEvaluator class for evaluating infix expressions, supporting functions, operators, constants, and brackets. Provides parsing, tokenization, and evaluation logic with extensible methods for custom behavior.

classes.name: AbstractEvaluator
classes.description: An abstract class for evaluating infix expressions with support for functions, operators, constants, and brackets. Thread-safe with customizable evaluation methods.

methods.name: validateHomonyms
methods.description: Validates that homonym operators are compatible; default allows only one unary and one binary operator with the same name.

methods.name: guessOperator
methods.description: Guesses the correct operator (unary or binary) based on previous token context.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Processes tokens to produce output values, handling literals, constants, and operators.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate a Constant, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate an Operator, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate a Function, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: doFunction
methods.description: Executes a function with given arguments and pushes the result.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Retrieves and reorders function arguments from the stack.

methods.name: toValue
methods.description: Converts a literal string to a value of type T; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression string, returning the result of type T.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression string with a given context, performing tokenization and parsing.

methods.name: toToken
methods.description: Converts a string token into a Token object, identifying functions, operators, brackets, or literals.

methods.name: getBracketPair
methods.description: Retrieves the BracketPair for a given token.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes an expression string into a sequence of tokens.
